difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts the relative Leray spectral sequence for a composition of morphisms of ringed topoi, with E_2 terms the pushforwards of the higher direct images and abutment the higher direct images along the composite, functorially in the module and with a version for bounded below complexes (statement lines 2366-2383, whose bracketed naming of the relative Leray spectral sequence is part of the environment and is delivered verbatim). The proof identifies the situation as a Grothendieck spectral sequence for a composition of functors (proof lines 2385-2388) and verifies the two acyclicity hypotheses through the companion results of the same chapter (proof lines 2388-2391). The non-formal content is the verification of the acyclicity hypotheses in this geometric setting. The claim is H2: one standard spectral sequence whose hypotheses the author checks by citing two results of the chapter.
